The part of a ring wall near the camera now fades out (from 14 m to 5 m away, the ground line from 3 m to 1 m), and the red start / checkpoint beams fade out when the camera is in them or within 2-8 m of them.

versions.summary: no more automatic /dm grove after joining, no roof spawns, rings hidden by walls.
items: **Auto deathmatch on join:** the red /dm grove start marker (3.21) stood exactly on the Grove Street spawn, so spawning there counted as walking into it and the Grove Street DM started by itself after 1.2 s. The same happened at Fort Carson (/dm minigun), Mount Chiliad (/dm sniper, /derby sumo), Idlewood (/job medic), Downtown LS (/job taxi) and El Corona (/job firetruck). Start markers are no longer placed within 30 m of a spawn spot or a hospital safe zone (those still start with their command), and a marker never starts by itself after you join, spawn, respawn, die or teleport: you have to leave it and walk / drive in yourself (4 s calm time after every jump).

**Spawning on roofs:** the ground search for teleports started 40 m above the point and took the first surface it hit: the roof of a house, a bridge, a tree. Now it looks just above the point first. DM spawns / respawns pick street points with open sky (12 tries, else the zone centre).

**Rings / beams through walls:** the red beams, the derby / DM ring, the green hospital safe zone rings and their labels were drawn over the game picture, so you saw them through houses like a ghost outline. Every corner is now checked with the game's line of sight from the camera (buildings + objects, cached 150 ms, max 220 checks per frame); parts behind a wall are not drawn. The Brief Case War briefcase marker stays visible through walls on purpose.

versions.summary: crash when tapping Connect (default server) with CLEO scripts installed.
items: Crash log (realme RE6054): SIGSEGV in `CRunningScript::ProcessCommands1100To1199`, opcode `0491` (HAS_CHAR_GOT_WEAPON) from a CLEO script. When you join, MP turns the phone's own street people / traffic off and removes the ones around you (the server's players replace them). A CLEO script that kept one of those people then asked the game about it and the game read a dead pointer. Same cause as the `0471` crash in 3.21.1, just another opcode - there are hundreds that take a person / car / object.

**Script fault guard:** every opcode range of the game (`ProcessCommands0To99` ... `2600To2699`) now runs inside a fault guard. An opcode that crashes no longer takes the game down: that one script is stopped on that opcode, every other script and the game keep running, and the AML log says `ScriptGuard: script 'xxx' crashed in opcode 0491 ... that script is stopped there`. MP's own commands are never stopped. Crashes outside scripts still go to AML's crash log as before. New Linux test `test/scriptfault_test.cpp` (real SIGSEGV, 200 in a row, nested, other threads, old handler).

versions.summary: launcher "+ Add" page - the extra Host switch is gone.
items: The "Host this server on my phone" switch is removed: **Add server** does both. With a Host / IP it saves the server to your list; with Host / IP empty it hosts the server on this phone (same name, port, password, language, icon, gamemodes). While it runs, the page shows "Hosting ..." with **Join my server** and **Stop my server**.

Crash fix: the switch started / stopped the server from inside the menu drawing, which removed players and cars while the game was still drawing them. Hosting and stopping now happen on the next game frame.

versions.summary: fix for the `LocateCharObjectCommand` crash (CLEO scripts, realme RE6054).
items: Two crash logs (SIGSEGV in `libGTASA.so + 0x34B6C0`, `CRunningScript::LocateCharObjectCommand`, opcode `0471` in R8) come from a CLEO script running `LOCATE_CHAR_ANY_MEANS_OBJECT_2D` (0471-0476) on a char or object that no longer exists: the game reads both handles and uses whatever comes back, also nothing. MP now hooks that game function itself (any caller: the game, CLEO, CLEOPlus, other mods): a dead char or object makes the check "false" and the script carries on with its next command, a script pointer of 0 does nothing. The AML log says `ScriptGuard: ... opcode 0471 ... skipped`. New Linux test `test/locate_test.cpp`.
The logs were made with MP 3.04.6: install 3.21.1 (the mod line in the AML log must say `version 3.21.1`).

versions.summary: hospital safe zones, red mission markers, no more "restart" when a phone host leaves, servers really update, crash guards.
items: **Hospital safe zones.** All 8 hospitals of San Andreas (All Saints and County General in Los Santos, Crippen Memorial in Montgomery, Angel Pine, San Fierro Medical Center, El Quebrados, Fort Carson, Las Venturas) are safe zones (32 m around the entrance, green ring + label, "SAFE ZONE" on screen). Inside one you can't be hurt: no bullets, no melee, no explosions or fire (also not from a player shooting in from outside), nobody can pull you out of a car, and your own weapon is switched to fists (no drive-by). The server checks it too, so a modded client can't get around it. Off in Brief Case War, races / derbies / DM and missions. Host option: `mp_server --no-safezones`.
**5 s spawn protection** after joining and after every respawn ("SPAWN PROTECTION 5" on screen): no damage from other players, and you can't hurt anyone either while it runs.

**Red SA-MP style markers.** Every job start, the derby arena and the DM zones have a red light beam with a label and the command, plus a radar blip (the 6 nearest within 800 m). Walk into the beam and stand still for a moment to start it. During a race / job the next checkpoint has a red beam and "CHECKPOINT x/y - d m" on screen; derbies and DMs show their red ring.

**More time.** Race queue: starts when 14 players are in, or after 45 s with 2 or more, or alone after 60 s; then a 20 s GO countdown (was 12 s) so everybody reaches the grid. Derby: 30 s lobby (8 s when alone), and 15 s (was 5 s) to get back into your car / the arena before you are out. Jobs: 5 s countdown.
**Brief Case War: no wanted level.** Being sent to Bone County (or anywhere) no longer gives you 4 stars: while you are in BCW your wanted level is held at 0.

**The host leaves -> the game no longer "restarts".** When a phone hosts a server and the 24/7 copy of the same server (HiveMQ / Termux machine) is online, MP 3.21 moves you to the 24/7 copy quietly (you keep playing where you are). When a phone host leaves, MP looks for the 24/7 copy first and waits for it (2 tries) instead of making another phone the host. The 24/7 copy always wins over phone copies.

**Servers really update now.** The HiveMQ kit's `install.sh` copied the new `mp_server` over the running one: that fails ("Text file busy") and stopped the update, so the 24/7 servers kept running an old `mp_server` - the reason the new admin key was refused, and why phones still became hosts. Fixed (copy + rename), plus a one-line update: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ThirtyFoxMCx00E1/HiveMQ/main/update.sh | sudo bash` (Termius console `7) update` uses it). Termux: `mp-server update` now also restarts the running server.

**Admin key.** Keep `administrator.txt` (new key) in `files/MP/`; you can also keep the old `admin.txt` next to it: MP 3.21 sends the new key first and the old one only to a server that is still old, and tells you which server needs the update.

**Crash guards (from the crash logs).** `LOCATE_CHAR_*_OBJECT_2D/3D` (0471-0476) with a dead char or object (CLEO script crash in `LocateCharObjectCommand`) is skipped; `CBaseModelInfo::SetColModel` with no model info (streaming crash) is skipped; the game's `fseek / ftell / fread / fwrite / fclose / fgets / feof` refuse a broken `FILE*` (Samsung A02 crash in `fseeko` with `FILE* = 1`). The AML log says what was blocked. Two other logs are not MP: a crash inside `libFHSpeedometer.so` (that mod jumps into the middle of the game's `CPed::GiveWeapon` - update or remove FHSpeedometer) and one in Android's own `libgui` binder thread (realme, Android 15).
Clothes / CJ outfit: loaded in the background (no freeze), and the mod version in the AML log now says 3.21.
Plays together with 3.11.x, 3.10 and 3.04.6.

versions.summary: new admin key in **administrator.txt**.
items: SENJI now has one new admin key, in a file called `administrator.txt` (same folder as before: `.../com.rockstargames.gtasa/files/MP/`). 3.11.6 servers accept only this key. The 2.37 key and the 3.10 key (`admin.txt`) no longer work on them.

Servers older than 3.11.6 don't know the new key, so they refuse SENJI. Update every server: HiveMQ servers `Termius > console > 7) update`, Termux phone servers `mp-server update`, phone hosts update MP.
The mod looks for `administrator.txt` (and `admin.txt`) in all the usual folders, as in 3.11.2.

versions.summary: guard against the game's streaming crash (`OS_FileSetPosition` / `OS_FileRead`).
items: Two crash reports (realme, Android 16, and Samsung A02, Android 11; both with 60+ mods and MP 3.04.6) crashed in the game's own model streaming thread (`libGTASA.so`, `OS_FileSetPosition`), reading through a null file handle. This is a known GTA SA mobile crash with IMG, streaming and limit mods. MP 3.11.5 checks the game's file functions (set position, read, size, get position, close): a null handle now makes that one read fail (the game skips or retries the model) instead of crashing the game, and the AML log says `FileGuard: ... blocked`. Valid files are not touched.

versions.summary: no crash when the game closes.
items: A crash report (Samsung A02, Android 11, 32-bit, 66 mods, MP 3.04.6) showed SIGABRT on a background thread while the game was closing. The aborting code was not MP's: none of the crash addresses match the MP library at any load address. But this crash type is typical of `exit()`: every library's global objects are destroyed while other mods' background threads (and MP's network and voice threads) are still running, and a thread that touches a destroyed mutex makes Android abort.

When the game closes, MP now ends the process at once, before any of those objects are destroyed, so this exit-time crash can't happen for any mod. If MP itself ever hits an uncaught C++ error, the AML log now says so before the crash report.

versions.summary: clearer message when a server refuses SENJI, plus old and new admin keys in one admin.txt.
items: If your admin.txt is valid but a server still refuses SENJI, the problem is not your phone. That **server program** runs an MP older than 3.10 and only knows the old admin key; servers on 3.10 or newer always accept both keys. The message now says this plainly and how to fix it (your 24/7 servers: Termius > console > **7) update**).

admin.txt can hold several keys, one per line (for example your old key and the new one). The mod tries the first key, and if a server refuses it, it retries the same server with the next key by itself.

versions.summary: SENJI can join again with admin.txt. 3.11.1, 3.11, 3.10 and 3.04.6 still play together.
items: On many phones AML keeps the game files in `/storage/emulated/0/Android_unprotected/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa/files/`, not in `/sdcard/Android/data/...`. If admin.txt was copied to the other folder, the mod never found it and refused the name SENJI on every server ("reserved for the administrator"). The mod now looks in both folders, in the `mods` folder, in `Download` and in the root of the storage, then copies the file into its own MP folder. If it still finds no valid admin.txt, it shows the exact folder to put it in.
Stray quotes or spaces around the key in admin.txt no longer matter.

If a server refuses SENJI even though your admin.txt is fine, that server runs an MP older than 3.10, which only knows the first admin key. The message now says so: update that server (24/7 servers: console menu **7) update**).

versions.summary: voice chat works on GTA SA apps without microphone permission. 3.11, 3.10 and 3.04.6 still play together.
items: Many GTA SA APKs don't list `android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO`. Android then blocks the microphone for the game, and it can't be allowed in Settings (the "Music and audio" permission is for audio files, not the mic). 3.11.1 notices this and uses the small **MP Voice** app (`release/MP-Voice.apk`, 17 KB, package `com.thirtyfox.mpvoice`), which has the microphone permission.

Install MP-Voice.apk once. In the game, tap the mic button, then turn the microphone on. The mod opens MP Voice by itself; MP Voice asks for the microphone the first time, turns it on and goes straight back to GTA SA. The notification "MP Voice microphone is on" shows while it runs, and it has a Stop button.

How it works: while your mic is on in the game, the mod tells MP Voice (`127.0.0.1:19228`, this phone only) every second. MP Voice records 48 kHz mono with echo cancellation and noise suppression, and sends every 20 ms frame straight back to the game. The game then compresses it with Opus and sends it like normal voice. When you turn the mic off in the game (or after 3 s without the game), MP Voice releases the microphone.
If the APK does have the permission, the game still uses the microphone directly, as in 3.11.

versions.summary: voice chat, chat timestamps, lower ping on the 24/7 servers, Discord message. **3.10 and 3.04.6 still work**: all three play together on the same servers and lobby (`thirtyfox/mp5/`).
items: **Voice chat.** A small white mic button sits next to Chat at the top: `[ ... ][ Chat ][ mic ]`. Tap it to open the voice panel: microphone on / off, a level bar, **Hear voice chat**, **Mute everybody**, voice volume, microphone boost, **voice pitch** (Deep / Normal / High / Chipmunk, or any value from 60 to 160 %) and **Hear myself** to test the pitch. It only works on a server; while you are not connected the button is grey. The mic button shows a red X while your mic is off and turns white with a green ring while you talk.

**Like real life.** Players right next to you are loud; further away they get quieter (4 m 100 %, 8 m 50 %, 16 m 25 %, 30 m ~12 %), and past 40 m you hear nothing. The server sends your voice only to players within 40 m.

**Who is talking.** A white speaker icon appears over a player's name tag while they talk and disappears as soon as they stop. The left side of the screen lists who is talking, like SA-MP mobile (`speaker Name (id)`).
**Mute a player.** Player list > tap a player > **Mute voice** (red X icon). Only you stop hearing them; it lasts until you restart the game. Players muted by the admin can't use voice either.

**How it works.** The microphone records 48 kHz mono with the phone's voice-call echo cancellation and noise suppression, and each 20 ms piece is compressed with Opus 1.6.1 (24 kbit/s, with packet-loss protection). It is sent the moment it is recorded, with no batching and no waiting for the game frame. Only speech is sent, so an open mic in a quiet room costs nothing. Each speaker has a small buffer that starts after 40 ms and never holds more than 100 ms, so the delay can't build up. On top of the network ping, voice adds about 100 ms. Lost pieces are rebuilt from the next one (Opus FEC) or covered over.
**Microphone permission.** Android asks for the microphone the first time you turn the mic on. If your GTA SA APK can't use the microphone, see 3.11.1 (MP Voice app). You can always hear the others.

**Chat timestamps.** Settings > Chat > **Chat timestamps [HH:MM:SS]** puts the time each line arrived in front of it, like SA-MP (`[18:02:48] Name: hi`). It is off until you turn it on and also works on lines that are already in the chat.

**Lower ping on the 24/7 servers (real, not a smoothed number).** Over mobile data every packet used to travel phone -> MQTT broker (TCP) -> server and back, batched every 25 ms. That path, plus TCP stalling on any lost packet, is where the 200-500 ms came from. A 24/7 server installed with the HiveMQ kit runs on the same machine as its region's broker, so the mod now asks that machine directly over UDP every 15 s. If the same server answers (same name and start time), the mod connects straight to it: one UDP hop each way, no TCP, no batching. The server list then shows that real, measured ping. If UDP is blocked on your network (no answer within 2.5 s), the mod falls back to the relay by itself. The server must have its UDP game ports (1922, and 1930 for Brief Case War) open to the internet; see the HiveMQ kit.

**Relay (phone-hosted servers).** Our own regional brokers now batch for 10 ms instead of 25 ms, and voice skips the batch entirely. HiveMQ runs on Generational ZGC (GC pauses under 1 ms instead of up to 20 ms), and the kernel no longer drops back to TCP slow start after a short pause (`tcp_slow_start_after_idle=0`), which caused spikes after a quiet moment.

**Discord message.** Every server running 3.11 sends `Join our discord server for more updates & info! https://discord.gg/ZqgXKYhNmv` to everyone on it every 45 min 20 s. There is one clock per server, started when the server starts, so a player joining never triggers it (no spam on join), and nothing is sent while the server is empty.

versions.summary: crash fix, clothing sync, 100-player default server, cheat-menu and reconnect fixes. **3.04.6 still works**: 3.04.6 and 3.10 play together on the same servers and the same lobby (`thirtyfox/mp5/`). Only 3.04.5 and older (the `mp4` versions with cheats) stay blocked.
items: **Crash fix (`CColTrianglePlane::Set`, fault address `0x5CAC`).** A bike (or any vehicle) touching a model whose collision still listed triangles but had no vertex array crashed the game (seen with `VehDeform32.so`). The new collision guard checks the data first in `CCollision::ProcessColModels` and both `CalculateTrianglePlanes`: a triangle list without vertices / triangles is switched off (the model keeps its spheres and boxes), logged as `ColGuard: broken collision data ... fixed`.

**Default server: 100 players.** After a phone hosted Brief Case War (20 slots) and then hosted the default server, the slot count was set while the old name was still in place, so the default server showed `0/20`. Now the name is set first and the default server is always 100.

**Brief Case War: no name tag on the connection screen.** Picking Gustav Team moves the camera to Verdant Meadows, near your hidden ped, and your own name tag was drawn over the view. Your tag is now hidden on the connection screen, while joining and while waiting to respawn.

**Clothing sync.** CJ's clothes, haircut, tattoos and fat / muscle are sent to everyone (on change + every 8 s, and to players who join later). Other phones rebuild your CJ the way the game builds the cutscene CJ (`csplay` in a special slot + `CClothes::ConstructPedModel`). Up to 3 differently dressed CJs are shown at once (the 3 MP special slots); anyone else is shown with their avatar skin, like before. Follows **Show my real model**. 3.04.6 phones and servers simply ignore it.

**Cheat Menu: no more false "you have a cheat menu".** Players who deleted `libCheatMenu.so` / `libCheatMenu64.so` were still refused: copies in other folders AML never loads from counted as installed, and a result was kept forever. Now only what is really loaded in the game counts and every check starts from scratch. The message says what is loaded and to restart the game after removing it.

**Cheat Menu permission is kept per server.** The **Cheat Menu** switch (Add server > permissions) used to be read from whichever phone was hosting: when another phone took over your server, its switch (off) was used and Cheat Menu players were refused. The permission is now saved with the server (learnt from its permissions while you are on it) and used by any 3.10 phone that hosts it.

**No reconnect to the server you are on.** Tapping the server you are already connected to (its row, Join, Connect) left it and went through the whole connection again. Now it says `You are already connected to ...`; the Leave button still leaves.
**Admin key.** A second admin key (new `admin.txt`) works on 3.10 phones / servers next to the old one (`[ADMIN] SENJI` name tag, chat and kill feed).
**HiveMQ kit.** The JDK download points to the new `Assets-1-2` release (OpenJDK 21.0.13+9).
**Website.** 3.10 and 3.04.6 can both be downloaded; older versions stay blocked.

versions.summary: **old versions are shut out** (they let players use cheats). Everyone must update to 3.04.6.
items: **Servers refuse old phones.** The mod now sends its build number when joining. Every server (24/7, Brief Case War, phone-hosted) refuses MP 3.04.5 and older with `Your MP version is too old. Download MP 3.04.6: thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu`, over Wi-Fi (LAN) and mobile data (internet) alike.
**Phones refuse old servers.** A server hosted by an old MP (it would let old cheaters in) is refused: `This server runs an old MP version`.

**New lobby.** The internet lobby moved from `thirtyfox/mp4/` to `thirtyfox/mp5/`. Old phones still have the broker login (`broker.txt` / `regions.txt`), but on the regional brokers they can only read the old lobby. There they see a single **UPDATE MP TO 3.04.6** server, and can't host anything. New phones never see old ones, not even on the free public brokers.

**Tracking.** Every refused old phone is written to `outdated_clients.log` next to the 24/7 server: time, name, version range (`2.37 - 3.04.5`, `2.25 - 2.36`, `2.19 - 2.24`, `2.18 or older`, judged from their join packet), phone id, IP and port. Each phone is logged once per 10 minutes. HiveMQ console: `o`.

**HiveMQ kit 3.04.6.** New topic rules, a new `mp-legacy` service (the UPDATE notice, using the bridge login), and MpBridge copies both lobbies. Run console option 7 (update) on every region, or the 3.04.6 phones can't see your 24/7 servers.
**Website.** Live server list on the new lobby, plus a **Version history** with every version. Only the latest one can be downloaded.
mp_server: `--outdated-log file`, `--legacy-notice`.

versions.summary: chat scale setting.
items: New **Chat scale (chat lines + chat box)** slider, 50 % to 200 %, in the MP Launcher under Settings > **Chat** (at the top) and Settings > **Display** (under the Chat switch). It scales the whole chat together: the chat lines, the "Tap to chat" box and the command suggestions. Quick buttons: Small 75 %, Normal 100 %, Big 130 %, Huge 160 %, plus a live preview line. It's saved in the config (`ChatScale`) and works on top of the chat text size. Also `/chatscale 50-200`. Reset chat layout sets it back to 100 %.

versions.summary: Brief Case War respawn on the connection screen.
items: When you die (after the game's own "wasted"), you go back to the Brief Case War connection screen, looking at **your own team's base** (Gustav: Verdant Meadows / Gant Bridge, Schelapz: Area 69 / Bayside Marina). It shows `YOU DIED`, your team, and a team-coloured **`Respawn in 10.95`** label button with a white cooldown bar: **10 s + 20 ticks**, counted in 20-tick steps. Then you spawn in your safe zone with your weapons and 5 s spawn protection (was: 30 s hidden, countdown under the crosshair). The server keeps you out of steals / captures and keeps the spawn protection for the new time.

versions.summary: Brief Case War base flags.
items: A very high team flag stands on each base coordinate: a 60 m pole with a gold top and an 18 x 10 m waving cloth, red with `GTV` on the Gustav base and blue with `SLZ` on the Schelapz base. It waves in a slowly turning wind and shows on the connection screen too. Far away the cloth grows (up to 4x), so you can always see where the enemy territory is.

versions.summary: Area 69 gate teleports.
items: The Area 69 fence gates never open in single player (the whole fence with its gates is one map object, model 16094 `des_a51infenc`). Now walk or drive up to one: the screen fades to black, you (and your car if you are the driver, passengers ride along) are moved to the other side, and the screen fades back in. A small yellow name floats over each gate when you are close. Works on every server, including Brief Case War (the Schelapz base is inside the fence).
Built-in gates: Area 69 North Gate (134.55, 1941.53) and Area 69 East Gate (286.01, 1822.74).
`/gatepos` prints a ready line with your position and facing; put it in `files/MP/gates.txt` (see `gates.example.txt`) and type `/gates reload`. `/gates` lists them.

versions.summary: Brief Case War fixes + score bar only for real gamemodes.
items: **Team buttons** are wider with slightly smaller text, so `Gustav Team 0/10` / `Schelapz Team 0/10` fit.

**Connection screen follows your team**: after tapping Gustav Team the camera moves to the Gustav base (Verdant Meadows Airfield on Bone County, Gant Bridge on San Fierro Bay); Schelapz Team shows Area 69 / Bayside Marina. Before a pick it shows the map overview.

**Score bar (top right)**: `DM SCORE / RACE SCORE / JOB SCORE / SCORE` only shows for gamemodes the server has. Brief Case War never shows it (it has its own HUD). A custom server shows DM score only with Deathmatch on, race score only with Races or Derbies on, job score only with Jobs on (MP Launcher > Add server > Gamemodes), and SCORE only together with one of them. A freeroam / RP server without them shows nothing. The default server keeps all of them.

versions.summary: **Brief Case War** - a private 24/7 capture-the-briefcase gamemode server (20 players, Gustav Team vs Schelapz Team).
items: **Server list.** "Brief Case War" is pinned in the MP Launcher Internet list right under the default server, with a red highlight, a red outline and a briefcase texture (`bcw_icon.png`, `bcw_briefcase.png`). It is always listed, even empty (`0/20`), like the default server. It is a private gamemode: it can't be created from "+ Add server" (the name and port 1930 are reserved). If no VPS runs it, the first phone that taps it hosts it.

**Rules.** Max **20 players = 10 per team**. MP cheats and the CLEO cheat menu are switched off automatically (Settings > Cheats shows them off), and phones with `libCheatMenu.so` / `libCheatMenu64.so` are refused, like on the default server. Other gamemodes and cheat / teleport commands (`/spawn`, `/w`, `/race`, ...) are off.

**Joining.** No Santa Maria beach: the connection screen looks at the war map (Area 69 on Bone County). The `< Spawn >` picker is replaced by **Gustav Team** (red) and **Schelapz Team** (blue) buttons with `n/10`. After a pick you can't move and wait in the queue (`WAITING FOR PLAYERS 12/20`). If a war is already running you join a team with a free slot straight away.
**Music.** `war_ambient.mp3` (put it in `files/MP`) starts 4 s + 20 ticks after connecting, fades in over 20 ticks and loops forever at 45 %.

**Leaders.** At 20/20 a slot machine rolls the names of each team in the centre of the screen (`user > user`), slows down and stops on the team leader. A player who was leader isn't picked again until everybody in the team had a turn.

**Teams.** Name tags `[GTV] name` (red) and `[SLZ] name` (blue), the leader gets `[Leader]`; chat names and the kill feed use the team colours too. Admins keep their own tag and colours. No friendly fire.

**Maps.** Bone County: Verdant Meadows Airfield (Gustav base, 372.50, 2500.50, 16.50) vs Area 69 Restricted Area (Schelapz base, 210.50, 1900.20, 17.60). San Fierro Bay: Pleasure Domes / Gant Bridge Base (-2680.00, 1590.00, 11.50) vs Bayside Boat Marina & Helipad (-2330.00, 2300.00, 4.30). 4 more maps are shown locked in the vote.

**Safe zones.** Each base has a glowing red / blue circle (radius 9) with flowing particles and a big floating base name, plus **3 vehicle spawner circles** (radius 4) with floating names: MILITARY VEHICLES (Patriot, Barracks), TANK (Rhino, only one), HELICOPTER (Hunter, only one); stand in one and the list pops up. Vehicles are synced like `/spawn`.
**World barrier.** An animated yellow-orange striped wall (Minecraft-style world border) 240 m around the war area (both bases); you can't get out on foot, by car, tank or helicopter.

**Briefcase.** Stand 5 s on foot in the enemy circle: a white progress bar with a thick black outline fills up near the bottom, then you carry their briefcase (model in your hand). Bring it to your own circle while your briefcase is at home = **victory**. If both briefcases are stolen nobody can win until a carrier is killed. Carriers get an x-ray outline in their team colour, visible through walls. A killed carrier drops the briefcase (highlighted with a beam, seen through walls); enemies pick it up, owners touching it send it home, and it goes home by itself after 60 s.

**Respawn.** You get your weapons when you spawn (M4, Desert Eagle, MP5, shotgun, sniper, grenades, 100 armour). After a death the game's own respawn (hospital / save point) is caught: you are hidden and frozen, then (3.04.4) you are back on the Brief Case War connection screen looking at your own team's base, with a `Respawn in 10.95` label button and a cooldown bar (10 s + 20 ticks, 20-tick steps), and you spawn in your team's safe zone with 5 s spawn protection. No wanted level in the war area.

**After a victory.** 24 s + 20 ticks **cooldown**: briefcases, briefcase objects and spawned war vehicles are cleared, everybody goes back to the connection screen (`Cooldown - resetting the war zone 24.95`). Then the **scoreboard**: top 3 most kills, `Gustav Team [Defeat] || Schelapz Team [Victory]`, every player with kills, deaths, K/D, steals, captures, returns, damage and score, and a Close button. Then the **map vote** (6 maps: 2 open, 4 locked, 20 s), and a new team queue.

Server: `server_bcw.inc` is the referee (queue, leaders, steal bars, carriers, drops, captures, stats, cooldown, scoreboard, vote), tested in `test/bcw_test.cpp` (a full 20-player match). 24/7: `./mp_server 1930 "Brief Case War" 20 Asia --persistent [--bcw-min 20]`; the HiveMQ kit installs it as `mp-bcw.service` (UDP 1930).

versions.summary: gamemode switches for custom servers, mission peds / cars synced to the mission group, turf box moved.
items: **Gamemodes.** MP Launcher > Add server > **Gamemodes**: Class selection, Turf wars, Races, Derbies, Deathmatch, Jobs, 3D text labels, Actors (+ All on / All off). Map icons and Chat bubbles are not gamemodes: each player switches them in Settings (Display > Map icons, Chat > Chat bubbles). The **default server always has all of them**. **Every custom server starts with all of them off** - only its owner turns them on. The switches are only for a **new** server you create (Host): a server that already exists always keeps the gamemodes it was created with - also when your phone ends up running it (joining a custom server nobody runs, host takeover, restart). Each phone remembers every custom server's gamemodes. Players on a custom server see "Gamemodes here: ..." on join, and a command of a gamemode that is off says so. 24/7 custom servers: `mp_server ... --gamemodes all` or a list (`--gamemodes class,turf,race,derby,dm,jobs,labels,actors`); without it: none.

**Mission sync: mission peds and cars.** Only the phone that starts a mission runs its script, so the others in the group saw the markers but none of the people / cars it made. Now the mission's peds and cars (enemies, homies, targets, mission vehicles near the player) are sent to the whole mission sync group (up to 16 players, tested with 14) and appear on their phones, moving, fighting and dying; their hits go to the mission owner's real ped. Tested in test/mission_npc_test.cpp.
**Turf box** moved from the bottom left (over the radar with a PC-style HUD) to the middle of the left edge.

versions.summary: crash fix (sound), GTA SA races with a 14-player queue, race scoreboard at the top, no name tags in class selection.
items: **Crash fix.** SIGSEGV in `libstagefright_foundation.so` (`android::MediaBuffer::~MediaBuffer`) on Android 16: the hit sound and the "connected" sound were played by OpenSL ES file players, which decode the mp3 in Android's media framework on its own threads; restarting / destroying them while decoding crashed it. The mp3s are now decoded once by MP itself ([minimp3](https://github.com/lieff/minimp3), CC0) and played from memory by buffer-queue players: the media framework isn't used any more.

**GTA SA races.** The 27 races of the single player Race Tournament with their real starts, checkpoints and vehicles (from the original script): Lowrider Race, Little Loop, Backroad Wanderer, City Circuit, Vinewood, Freeway, Into the Country, Badlands A + B, Dirtbike Danger, Bandito County, Go-Go Karting, San Fierro Fastlane, San Fierro Hills, Country Endurance, SF to LV, Dam Rider, Desert Tricks, LV Ringroad, the air races World War Ace, Barnstorming, Military Service, Chopper Checkpoint, Whirly Bird Waypoint, Heli Hell, and 8-Track + Dirt Track in the stadiums (4 and 3 laps). The old custom races 1-12 are gone.

**Race queue.** `/race` puts you in the queue (you stay where you are, "RACE QUEUE 3/14" at the top). When **14 players** are in it, the server picks a race and everybody is teleported to it at the same time, each on their own grid place, in the race vehicle, 3-2-1-GO together. `/leave` leaves the queue. `/races` lists the 27 tracks (Mark = the start on your radar for 90 s). Needs the 3.02 server.
**Race scoreboard** at the top centre, a little above the crosshair: `POS 3/14   CP 7/27   TIME 1:23.456` (derbies and jobs use the same spot).
**Class selection** (`/class`) hides all name tags, 3D labels and chat bubbles, like SA-MP.
Server: race queue (`RaceQueueTick`), tested in test/racequeue_test.cpp. Update the 24/7 servers (HiveMQ console option 7, or `mp-server update` on Termux).

versions.summary: SA-MP features: class selection, gang zones + turf wars, derbies, races with other players, dialogs, textdraws, 3D labels, map icons, actors.
items: **Class selection (`/class`).** The SA-MP spawn screen: `<<` `>>` `SPAWN` `CANCEL` with a fixed camera on your player. 30 classes: Grove Street Families (CJ, 105-107), Ballas (102-104), Los Santos Vagos (108-110), Varrios Los Aztecas (114-116), San Fierro Rifa (173-175), Da Nang Boys (121-123), Police (280-282) and civilians (your own skin, 7, 19, 29, 101, 170, 188, 250). Spawn puts you at your team's spawn; the team and skin are saved (`Team`, `ClassSkin`). On story missions you are CJ again (cutscenes need him), the class skin comes back after. Name tags are unchanged (RGB + rank only).

**Gang zones + turf wars (`/turf`, `/teams`).** 24 zones (20 Los Santos, 4 San Fierro) drawn by the game on the radar and the map in the owner's colour; a zone under attack flashes in the attacker's colour. Stand in an enemy zone for 60 s with your gang to take it ("TURF: X took Y from Z!" for everybody). Bottom-left HUD: zone name, owner, war progress. `/turf` lists all zones (Mark = radar blip for 90 s), `/teams` shows turf and players per gang. The server decides and saves the owners (`turf.txt`).

**Derbies (`/derby`).** Last car standing: Blood Bowl Derby and Monster Truck Derby (stadium interior 15), Ocean Docks Derby, Verdant Meadows Derby and Chiliad Sumo. You are out when your car is wrecked or under 250 HP, you are out of it for 5 s, out of the arena for 5 s or (sumo) fall off. Alone: survive 60 s. Time limit 4 minutes. You go back to where you came from after.
**Races with other players.** Same grid, same GO (3, 2, 1 in Pricedown), live POS / CP / TIME, prize by place, "finished 1st / 2nd / 3rd" announced (3.02: GTA SA races + 14-player queue).

**Dialogs.** `/race`, `/job`, `/dm`, `/derby` with nothing after open SA-MP list dialogs (name, vehicle, prize, best time, who is racing). Message box, input, list, password, tablist and tablist-with-headers styles, `{RRGGBB}` colours, the same look as SA-MP. The server can send dialogs too (welcome dialog on join).

**Textdraws.** SA-MP game texts (styles 1, 3, 4, 6) and textdraws with `~r~ ~g~ ~b~ ~y~ ~w~ ~h~ ~n~` codes, boxes, outlines, alignment, in Pricedown when it is installed; the server can show its own (banner).

**Chat bubbles (option, off by default).** What a player types shows over their head for a few seconds (SA-MP chat bubble, `{RRGGBB}` colours, up to 4 wrapped lines, hidden behind walls and beyond the name tag distance). Off until you turn it on: MP Launcher > Settings > Chat > **Chat bubbles** (or `/bubbles`). Saved as `ChatBubbles` in the MP config.
**3D text labels.** Over every race, job, derby and DM start and every gang spawn, within 35 m, hidden behind walls (`/labels`).

**Map icons.** SA-MP map icon ids on the radar: race flag, trucking, quarry, pizza, Burger Shot, Cluckin' Bell, hospital, fire, car, enemy attack (DM), race (derby) and the gang icons at the spawns (`/icons`).

**Actors.** People standing at the job starts (pizza, Burger Shot, Cluckin' Bell, trucker, quarry worker, taxi driver, paramedic, firefighter), a Grove member at race 1 and a guard at the War Zone; they can't be hurt and are never shared as NPCs (`/actors`).
**Admin kill popup removed.** No more fire flash, rings or "ADMIN KILL" on an admin kill: the kill feed line is a normal line (still with the RGB rank + name).
Settings > Display: 3D text labels, map icons, actors, gang zones switches.

Server (`mp_server`): `--motd "text"` / `--motd-file motd.txt` (welcome dialog), `--banner "text"` (textdraw bottom right), `--turf-file turf.txt`, `--no-turf`. New packets PKT_EVENT, PKT_TEAM, PKT_TURF, PKT_DIALOG, PKT_DIALOG_RESPONSE, PKT_TEXTDRAW. Tested in test/samp301_test.cpp.
Update every phone and the 24/7 servers (HiveMQ console option 7, or `mp-server update` on Termux).

versions.summary: Hit sound, Cheat Menu permission for custom servers, coloured Pricedown score bar.
items: **Hit sound.** `assets/MP/sound_010.mp3` plays when your hit lands on a player: guns, fists, knife / bat and the other melee weapons, drive-by and car rams. Fists used to be silent: a punch can take HP off without the game noting who did it, so it was not counted (no damage sent, no sound). Now a punch that lands in front of you within 2.5 m counts as yours, and a punch that lands but takes almost no HP still sounds. The sound is loaded once and only restarted per hit (3 voices), so a minigun doesn't stutter; at most one sound every 70 ms.
**Settings > Sound** (new page in the MP Launcher): **Hitsound effect** switch (enable / disable) and a Test button. Saved as `HitSound` in the MP config.

**Cheat Menu permission (custom servers).** Add server > scroll down to the permissions (under Mission sync) > **Cheat Menu** on / off. On: players with Cheat Menu (libCheatMenu.so / libCheatMenu64.so) join directly, no message, and its button / window work. Off (default): they get "This server doesn't allow cheat menus" and leave right away. Never on the default server (the server strips the permission), and "Disable cheats" switches it off too. Hosting your own server with Cheat Menu installed works only when your switch is on. 24/7 servers: `mp_server ... --cheat-menu`. New permission bit `PERM_CHEAT_MENU = 4` (older servers never send it = not allowed). Tested in test/cheatperm_test.cpp.

**Score bar (top right): one colour per score, in Pricedown.** DM SCORE blue, RACE SCORE yellow, JOB SCORE red, SCORE green, with a thick black edge like the HUD money. MP draws it itself with the bundled `assets/MP/pricedown.ttf` (the original freeware Pricedown, (c) 1998 Ray Larabie, unchanged; licence in `assets/MP/PRICEDOWN_LICENSE.txt`). The first build tried to draw it through the game's own font, but that didn't show on the phone, so you saw the default font. MP also picks up a pricedown .ttf from other mods' folders if the MP one is missing; the game font and then Arial are the last fallbacks.
**MP Launcher icon** in the title bar is white (was green).

**Admin look without dragons.** Name tag, chat and kill feed show only the RGB `[ADMIN]` rank and the flowing SENJI name; the dragons are removed (code too). The name tag sits at the normal height again. The fire flash + "ADMIN KILL" on an admin kill stays.
Update every phone and the 24/7 servers (HiveMQ console option 7, or `mp-server update` on Termux).

versions.summary: Administrator, CheatMenu block, launcher clean-up and ramming fixes.
items: **Default server administrator = SENJI.** Joining the default server first no longer makes you its host (administrator); the phone that happens to host it gets no admin powers either. The administrator is the player named SENJI, and the proof is the file `files/MP/admin.txt` (`/sdcard/Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa/files/MP/admin.txt`, one line: the admin key). The server checks the key (only its SHA-256 is in the source; the 24/7 server can use another one with `mp_server --admin-hash <hex>`). On the default server he shows as **[ADMIN] SENJI**: the `[ADMIN]` rank is an animated RGB wave (red, blue, violet, yellow, green) and the name SENJI flows white/black, in name tags, chat, kill feed and the player list. From MP Launcher > Players he can kick, ban, mute / unmute, and Settings > Cheats > "Disable cheats" switches cheats off for everyone (reset when everybody has left). Nobody else can use a fake `[ADMIN]` tag (it is removed by the server).

**The name SENJI is reserved.** Without `admin.txt` the name (also look-alikes like `senji`, `S_E_N_J_I`, `SENJ1`) turns red in the keyboard and Enter does nothing, the mod refuses to connect with it, and the server refuses the join (`REJECT_NAME_RESERVED`), so editing the config doesn't help either.

**CheatMenu is not allowed.** `libCheatMenu.so` / `libCheatMenu64.so` is detected in `ON_ALL_MODS_LOAD` with `aml->HasMod()` (+ `aml->GetLib()`, the loaded libraries and the AML mods folders), and again before every join and every 5 s while connected. If it is found, joining the default server or any custom server and hosting are refused with a "This server doesn't allow cheat menus" window telling you to remove the file and restart; it still works in single player.
**Default server stays 24/7.** When everybody has left, the server keeps running and stays in the list.

**Launcher: "Hosted" merged into "Add server".** The two pages had the same server name, port, password, language, icon, max players and permission switches. Now there is one page: fill it in once, then "Add server" (with a Host / IP) or "Host this server on my phone" (Host / IP empty). Permission switches are shown once.

**Tug Stairs no longer flies.** Trailers (Tug Stairs, baggage, farm, utility, article trailers) can't be spawned with /spawn, a player who gets into one (cheat / CLEO) is put next to it, and other phones don't build a flying copy.

**Ramming is no longer a one-hit kill.** A car hitting a player on foot used to send the whole avatar damage (or "instant kill"). Now a ram is scaled by speed and capped at 20 HP, once per 0.7 s per attacker; the victim's phone enforces the cap too, so older or modified phones can't exploit it. Rams from trailers do nothing. Drive-by shooting and vehicle weapons are unchanged.

**Kill feed: new car-hit icon.** Running somebody over showed the driver's hand weapon (the damage was sent with the weapon in his hand). Car hits are now marked as car damage (also when an older phone sends them) and the kill feed shows a car-hits-player icon; heli blades got their own icon.

**Admin name effects (one style per place).** Name tag: a golden Chinese dragon circles the name (front half passes under the letters, back half behind them) chasing a flaming pearl, with a breathing aura, rising embers, glints and a light sweep. Chat: a jade dragon swims under your 2 newest lines. Kill feed: a crimson fire dragon orbits the name. The body is a shaded ribbon with belly plates, scales, a rippling crest, clawed legs and a flowing tail; the head has antlers, mane, beard, a glowing eye, an opening jaw and trailing whiskers. Motion uses smooth noise (no two laps the same) and runs every frame. Your own tag and chat show it at once; others see it once the server tags you (every server now gives `[ADMIN] SENJI` the rank; admin powers stay on the default server). With admin.txt and the name SENJI, a live preview shows under the Name field.

**Admin kill popup.** When [ADMIN] SENJI gets a kill, the line pops big and settles, with a fireball flash, two shockwave rings, flying sparks, smoke, a crimson dragon swooping across and "ADMIN KILL" stamping in.

**Kill feed without the delay.** A kill used to appear only after your hit reached the victim's phone, it noticed its own death and the death came back (2 round trips, ~0.5-1.5 s on the internet relay). Now your phone shows the kill the moment your hit is lethal (from the victim's last health + armour); the victim's death confirms it without a second line, replaces it if somebody else got the kill, or removes it after 3 s if they survived.

**Admin tag clears the health bar.** The [ADMIN] SENJI name and its dragon sit higher, so the dragon never covers the health / armour bars. The bars stay in the normal place; every other player's tag is unchanged.
**One dragon in the kill feed.** The admin kill popup no longer adds a second swooping dragon; only the one circling the name stays (flash, rings, sparks and "ADMIN KILL" are kept).

**Everyone sees the admin effects.** The server sends the name `[ADMIN] SENJI` to every player, and every 2.37 mod draws the name tag, chat and kill feed effects from it (checked in test/admin_test.cpp). Players on an older mod, or on a server that isn't updated to 2.37, see a plain name.

**ScriptGuard: crash in CPhysical::Add fixed** (SIGSEGV at libGTASA.so + 0x3FCF6C, 32-bit, 68 mods). Every car / ped / object added to the world, by MP, CLEO or any other mod, is checked first. Past the map edge: moved back inside and stopped (a negative sector used to read memory in front of the sector table). NaN position or a broken / huge bounding box: not added. World node pools nearly full: not added (a null node used to crash). Each case is written to the AML log (`ScriptGuard: CPhysical::Add ...`). Tested in test/addguard_test.cpp.

**Renamed CheatMenu is caught and its button removed.** Renaming libCheatMenu.so no longer works: every lib in the mods folders is read and checked for the menu's own Dear ImGui label "CheatMenu" / "Cheat Menu" (MP's own libs are recognised and skipped). When found, MP still refuses every server, and the menu's ImGui is hooked: the small "CheatMenu" button at the bottom of the screen is no longer drawn and can't be pressed, and if its window opens anyway it is moved off-screen, closed and draws nothing. Logged as `ModScan: ...`. Tested in test/modscan_test.cpp.
Update every phone and the 24/7 servers (HiveMQ console option 7, or `mp-server update` on Termux).

versions.summary: Disable cheats (host setting). MP Launcher > Settings > Cheats has one switch, "Disable cheats". Only the host can turn it on (the phone running the server; on the default server that is the first player who joined). When it is on, for every player on that server: the MP cheat commands (/fly, /god, /invincible, /nofall, /wh, /freeze, /invisible, /flash, /gravity, /tp, /behind) are refused and any that were on are turned off, and the CLEO menu (swipe down) and CLEO touch / swipe menu scripts get no touches (an open CLEO menu is closed). The CLEO part works with CLEO Android (CLEOMod, 32-bit game); the switch is sent as a server permission, so no server update is needed.

One shared world when players drive / walk together. Every phone runs the same game scripts (parked-car generators, gang / dealer peds), and each phone also sent those as "its spawned" ones, so two or three players together saw the same people and cars two or three times (worlds merged). Now a phone only shares what it really made: things that first appear right next to that player (CLEO menu / spawner / summon) or a car the player drove; and a shared car / ped is not shown when the same one already stands there. The copy of a driven NPC car no longer gets out by itself (its driver is a sync-only puppet that stays in the car) and is deleted with its car instead of being left behind as a second person. Visible enter / exit: other players now walk to the door and get in / out with the game's real animation for that car type (CAR_getin / getout, bikes, trucks, bus, ...) instead of teleporting; when they get out, the car stays parked where it was instead of vanishing and popping back. The kill feed is cleared when you leave the server. While the MP Launcher is open the game's HUD (radar, weapon, buttons) and MP's own HUD (tags, chat, kill feed) are hidden and get no touches. No server change.

NPC flicker fix - cars / people driving or walking past players no longer blink out and back in (a copy near a player was deleted and re-made every packet, and cars were pushed out of the packet when the number of spawned ones changed; the packet is now sticky as a whole). Cars you spawn with a CLEO menu / vehicle spawner / summon are no longer deleted when you are near other players (empty cars and cars that appear right next to you are kept; only traffic that drives in is removed) - other players see them. Taking another player's NPC car needs you to really be at the car. Crash log `CPhysical::Add` (SEGV_UNKNOWN): the signal was sent by the game process itself, not a bad position (the ped was inside the map, Ganton) - fewer cars / people are now deleted and re-created by MP, which lowers that load.

Crash fix in `CPhysical::Add` (libGTASA + 0x3FCF6C, SIGSEGV): MP put an entity outside the world grid (+-3000 m) or at an invalid (NaN) position - a remote player beyond the map edge (plane, jetpack, teleport cheat) or a bad packet - and the game read past its sector arrays. Every position / speed MP gives the game (avatars, their cars, NPC copies, aim / shoot targets, explosions, fires, pickups) is now checked: garbage is dropped, positions are kept inside the map, speeds max 150 m/s and never further out past the edge.

Fixed: remote players turning into bots (a player's avatar walking around on its own like a normal ped, or a frozen player while others move). A mission ending, "clear area" or a CLEO cleanup released MP's avatars to the game (script ped -> street ped): they got the game's own wander / flee brain and the NPC sync even shared them as pedestrians. Now every avatar ped / car is locked as a sync-only puppet 4x a second (never released, empty decision maker): only the real player's controls move it. Every avatar MP makes is tracked; it is never shared as an NPC, and a leftover avatar no player owns is deleted. Phones also ignore a "NPC" that is really a player (at a player's position, or with a player's skin near them), so older phones can't send these bots either.
items: **Fixed: gun arm / elbow not raised when another player aims or shoots.** The aim task was restarted every 300 ms, so the "raise the gun" motion never finished, and the copied body anims covered the arms. Now the aim is given once and renewed only when the aim point moves, the mirrored anims step aside while aiming, and aiming while walking / strafing raises the gun too.
Server icons: the slot numbers are gone from all 250 pictures (rebuilt from the original Wikimedia Commons photos) and from the menus.
Update every phone (and the hosting phone) to 2.32.

versions.summary: Mission sync for more than 2 players: up to 16 players in one Mission sync group (3+ friends can all do the same mission together, see each other and share the mission markers). Ask any member and accept to join the group. In the player list, a synced player has an **Unsync mission** button that takes only that player out of your mission sync; **Leave Mission sync** takes you out while the rest stay synced. The list shows the whole group ("Mission sync (3/16): you, A, B"). The server must be 2.31 too (also the 24/7 `mp_server`). Test: `test/group_test.cpp`.

MP Launcher watermark: "powered by HiveMQ/ThirtyFoxMC" on the right side of the title bar (left of the close button), green at 50% transparency. It hides itself on narrow screens rather than covering the launcher name.

The default server "MP LAN Server" is always there. A 24/7 server (`mp_server --persistent`: the region VPS from the HiveMQ repo or a Termux phone that stays on) is announced in the lobby as dedicated (`@start!d`; older phones ignore it) and always wins over a phone copy: phones join it first, a phone already hosting a copy moves its players there, and when a phone host leaves everybody lands on the 24/7 copy instead of the server disappearing. `mp_server --persistent` no longer exits (code 2, restart loop) when a phone already runs the same server; it starts anyway and takes the players over. Port 1922 without a name = "MP LAN Server". The default server always has 100 slots, also when a phone hosts it, and the Internet tab always lists it (0/100 when nobody plays; Join starts it).

Crash fix in `CRunningScript::ProcessCommands1000To1099` (libGTASA + 0x34EB76, called from `Game::GetCharTagPos` -> `Game::GetPassengerSeat`): passenger name tags asked the game who sits in every seat of a player's car with opcode 0432, and the game crashes on an empty seat or a car that was just deleted. Empty seats are now skipped and every car / ped query checks the handle is still alive; ScriptGuard also skips 0432 with a dead car for any script (CLEO too). Player list: tapping a name only selects it. No more teleport + "flying" glitch: touches on MP windows no longer reach the game HUD / CLEO touch-zone shortcuts behind the list, and **Go behind** is no longer instant: 3 2 1 countdown in the middle of the screen with Cancel, cancelled if the player leaves, pauses, is in another interior, on a mission or their position is old, 30 s cooldown (time limit) shown on the button, safe landing (ground found, clear of their car, speed zeroed, held still for 0.7 s). `/behind [id|stop]` uses the same countdown. Shared world: cars and people spawned by a script (CLEO cheat menus, `/v`, ...) and cars left parked by their driver are now synced to every player near them (new `*_SPAWNED` NPC flag, works without being the NPC host), so everybody sees the same car / ped in the same place instead of each phone having its own; getting in one claims it, damage goes to its owner. The host's ping is now real: the host's game talks to the server on its own phone (127.0.0.1 = 0-1 ms), so the host now shows the round trip to the online relay (HiveMQ broker) the players' packets go through, or the players' average ping on Wi-Fi / LAN.

Fixed "someone joins and I get Connecting... / resources / Connected successfully again" (and the teleport to Grove Street). A phone that joined before it could see your server started its own copy of the same server; the duplicate merge then broke the 1-1 tie by token / IP, so the player who was already playing sometimes had to leave and rejoin the newcomer's copy. Every server now announces when it started (Wi-Fi query + online listing `proto:icon@start:language`, older phones still read it) and on a tie the older copy always wins, so the newcomer moves, not you. Moving to another copy of the same server (duplicate merge or host takeover) is now silent: no Connecting feed, no resource list, no teleport, you keep playing where you are. 24/7 server announces its start time too.

Crash fix in `CPed::GiveWeapon` (libGTASA + 0x49F61E): another player's weapon is now only given when it is a real SA weapon (19-21 are empty slots), its model really loaded (weapon mods / full streaming) and the avatar still exists; goggles (44/45) and the parachute (46) are never given to avatars (they need player data only your own CJ has). A weapon that fails 3 times shows fists instead of retrying. The launcher is now a real full-screen window: while it is open nothing behind it gets your touches (no more hitting the game HUD through it), the game behind is dimmed, and the floating ⋮ / Chat buttons and the chat box are hidden until you close it with X. Server icons: the 250 + 1 icons (`icon_1.png` ... `icon_250.png` and `main_df_icon.png`) are now real photos from [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org) (horror, gangs / street art / lowriders, artists / concerts, cars, bikes, Los Santos / Las Venturas / San Fierro style cities, guns, games and arcades, wild animals), each free to share; author + license of every icon in `files/MP/ICONS_CREDITS.txt`.

New full-screen server launcher (Orbit Launcher style). Tapping **Server** in the floating menu now opens an almost full-screen window (95% of the screen, 40% see-through): title bar "MP Launcher v2.25", toolbar (search, Connect / Leave, add, delete, refresh, settings, your nickname, display settings, help), left sidebar (Servers: Internet, Favorites, Hosted, Add server; Admin: Players, Bans; Settings: every other menu page), the server table (padlock, icon, HostName, Players, Ping, Mode, Language; tap a header to sort, tap a row to select, tap it again to join) and a right panel with the selected server's players (Player | Score) and rules (address, port, region, language, version...). Player management for hosts: kick or ban any player with a reason (type one or tap Cheating / Spamming / Insulting / Griefing / Bug abuse / AFK); bans use the player's phone id (new `DeviceId` in the config), so a new nickname doesn't help; ban list with unban and "ban a name" in Admin > Bans (saved in `files/MP/bans.txt`). Kicked / banned players see the SA-MP style box "You are banned from the server!" with Server, Ban date, Administrator (the host) and Reason; older phones get the same text in the chat. Server language: pick or type it on Host your own server and on Add server (e.g. `English`, `Filipino / English`); it shows in everyone's Language column and the search also finds it. 250 new server icons from [game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net) (CC BY 3.0, credits in `files/MP/ICONS_CREDITS.txt`): guns, skulls, gangs, cars, crews, music and artists. 24/7 server: `--lang`, `--admin NAME`, `--bans FILE` and console commands `players`, `kick <id> [reason]`, `ban <id> [reason]`, `banname <name> [reason]`, `bans`, `unban <n>` (Termux `server.conf`: `SERVER_LANG=`, `ADMIN=`). Repository renamed to **wagu**: website now [thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu](https://thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu/) (regions.txt moved with it).

Crash fix + server icons. Fixed a crash in `CStreaming::RequestModel` (libGTASA + 0x2D2AAE): NPC world sync requested the car / ped model ids sent by the host's phone before checking them, so a model the host has but your game doesn't (limit adjusters, modded peds/cars, garbage ids) crashed. Every model is now checked against this game's model table before it is requested. Server icons: 250 template icons `files/MP/icon_1.png` ... `icon_250.png` plus the default `main_df_icon.png` (replace any of them with your own PNG, max 256x256). Hosts pick theirs in Server > Host your own server: tap the icon for the next one (Default -> 1 ... 250 -> Default), or use - / + / Default. Every phone shows the icon in the server list (online lobby, Wi-Fi and saved servers); the default MP LAN Server always shows `main_df_icon.png`. Older phones still see the server normally (the icon rides behind the protocol number). 24/7 server: `--icon N` / `ICON=N` in server.conf.

Lobby no longer flips online / offline when the region servers are down. A region now counts as "up" only when a real MQTT login works (before: a plain TCP connect, which a router or firewall can accept on every port without a broker behind it). Region checks run in parallel (~5 s instead of ~40 s), the first connect waits for them, dead regions are skipped instead of costing 4-8 s each on every reconnect, failed brokers back off (30 s up to 10 min), and the mod never drops a working public-lobby connection to try a region that is down. Connection page shows "All regions down: staying on the public lobby". Same fix for the 24/7 server (`mp_server`, Termux).

Crash + chat fix. The touch hook (Android UI thread) no longer touches ImGui while the game thread is drawing it: touches are queued and applied on the game thread, and the menu/chat hit test uses a snapshot of the last frame. This removes a heap race that could crash anywhere (often reported as `SIGSEGV` inside `libart.so`) and the stale-position taps that opened the chat "anywhere I press". The chat box only opens on a real short tap on the box. New in **Server > Display** (scroll down) and **Chat**: chat lines position X/Y, own chat box position (or right under the chat), show/hide the chat background, the chat box background and the "Tap to chat" label, and "Tap the chat box to type" (off = only the Chat button opens the keyboard, taps go to the game). New config keys: `ChatBoxBackground`, `ChatBoxLabel`, `ChatBoxTap`, `ChatBoxX`, `ChatBoxY`. Website: new [Termux page](https://thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu/termux.html) for the 24/7 phone server, and the MP Bot now runs Termius + Termux by itself (types the command, presses Enter, reacts to region / server changes, no input box). `regions.txt` now lists the HiveMQ public cluster as the shared Asia lobby (same lobby for 2.19-2.22 phones and the Termux 24/7 server) and `broker.txt` is ready to copy. HiveMQ kit: autopilot (auto-restart + reports shown by the MP Bot).

Stability + games. No more random 5-minute "timeout" kicks: the mod stays on the same broker during a game (no background region switch), reconnects to the last good broker within a second, detects dead relay sockets after 7 s, ignores short network blips (3 checks) and the game timeout is 20 s instead of 10 s. "Please wait" no longer appears while a server is online: background lobby jobs no longer block Join/Host, and Join waits up to 4.5 s for the server list. One shared broker login for 100 phones is safe (each phone has its own client id). NPC world sync like normal SA-MP: one stable NPC host (keeps the same 48 people / 32 cars instead of flickering), NPC copies and player avatars no longer attack the host (empty decision maker), wanted level no longer swaps the NPC host. Passenger name tags sit above the right seat. Open world: all cities, safe houses, schools, Pay 'n' Spray, barbers, Well Stacked Pizza, Burger Shot, Cluckin' Bell, tattoo, gyms, clothes, mod garages, Ammu-Nation, trucking, quarry, Emmet, race tournaments (`/unlock`, `/girlfriends` optional). Games for the default and custom servers: `/spawn id|name` (vehicles 400-611), `/w` weapons, `/fix /flip /heal /armour`, 37 teleports announced in chat (`(/ls) Name teleported to Los Santos!`), 8 races with checkpoints and times (`RACE: Name finished Off-Road Race 1! (1/2 - 1:20.994)`), 8 jobs, 5 deathmatch zones (`/war`), kill streak and wanted announcements, score bar (DM / RACE / JOB SCORE), chat tips. 125 built-in server resources (35 new). Website: new [Termius page](https://thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu/termius.html) (24/7 region status, live servers, ping, browser terminal of each HiveMQ server). HiveMQ kit: web console, status beacon, phone-only cloud-init setup.

Regional lobby servers. The mod downloads `regions.txt` from the website ([thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu](https://thirtyfoxmcx00e1.github.io/wagu/)), measures the ping to the Asia, Europe, NA and Oceania brokers in the background and joins the fastest one (MP menu shows "Asia 38 ms" etc. on the region buttons; "Lobby: lowest ping region" toggle). Hosting uses your server's region; joining a server from another region moves you to that region's broker and back afterwards. Server lists are shared between regions by the bridge, so everyone still sees every server. Until regions are filled in, the free public lobby is used exactly like 2.19. `broker.txt` now also accepts `[Asia]`/`[Europe]`/`[NA]`/`[Oceania]` blocks, `mqtt://`/`mqtts://` prefixes and `regions_url=` (`off` to disable). New website with live server list and region ping (`docs/`). Self-hosted HiveMQ regional broker kit: [ThirtyFoxMCx00E1/HiveMQ](https://github.com/ThirtyFoxMCx00E1/HiveMQ).

Fixed the "100% progress: couldn't back up your saves" spam + lag on the default server: after a failure the save backup was retried every frame (copying every save file and posting the message each time). Now it gives up once per session. Empty or unreadable save slots no longer make the backup fail - they are just left untouched.

Player model sync: others now see your real ped model (skin mods, skin-changer scripts, story characters loaded by scripts); CJ players are shown with the avatar skin from the menu (Player > Show my real model). Story characters (special characters) work as avatar skins and over the network: Rose, Paul, Cesar, OG Loc, Woozie, Mike Toreno, Jizzy, Madd Dogg, Catalina, Claude (SA-MP ids 290-299) plus Kendl, The Truth, Maccer, Emmet, T-Bone, Jethro, Zero, Andre (312-319), loaded into MP's own special slots 8-10 on each phone. More gang / cop skins in the picker. Chat no longer covers the screen: lines shown, text size, width (long lines wrap), fade-out time, background and position are set in game (Server > Chat, or /pagesize /fontsize /chatwidth /chatfade /chatbg /clearchat). Hosting fixed: Host server with the default name / port no longer just joins the default server - it gets "<your name>'s server" on port 1923 and you join it right away; "Leave + join my server" while on another server; your own password is used when you join your own server. Sync status (animations, story characters, NPCs) shown under Display.

While the virtual keyboard is open, taps no longer reach the game HUD behind it (radar / map, weapon, enter-car and other buttons, camera swipes). Remote players no longer T-pose when walking or running without the sprint button: plain walk / run now uses the game's own walk at the same gait (sprint, jumps, fights etc. are still mirrored).
The passenger icon only shows next to a car another player is driving (they got in first). Next to empty or parked cars and traffic there is no icon, so you just get in as the driver.
The Passenger button is now an icon: a car seen from above with its door open, white with a dark outline and no background. It shrinks a little while you press it.
Crash fix.
items: Fixed a game crash (SIGSEGV in `CPed::GiveWeapon`) that could happen when another player used a jetpack. The 2.19 jetpack sync gave the avatar on your phone the game's real jetpack, but the game only supports that on the player, not on other characters. Avatars now carry a jetpack model on their back instead, and the flight comes from the position sync.
Weapons are never given to a character that is already gone, and only valid weapon ids are used.

versions.summary: Fixes for 2.19, plus a Local IP join and a Passenger button.

A long label goes on its own line instead of running under the field. The extra password field under "Delete selected" (it overlapped and opened the keyboard) is gone; the password goes in when you add the server.
**Local IP**: new section on the Server page: type the IP and the port, tap Connect (same Wi-Fi / hotspot, or a public IP). It also shows your own local IP.
